operations.summary: old release updates email in users only
new release tombstones in users_v2 then deletes from users
backfill reads users and upserts into users_v2 clearing deleted_at

conflicts.risk_explanation: delete_user tombstones by setting deleted_at=now() while copy_users upsert unconditionally sets deleted_at=NULL. A copy that SELECTs before the DELETE but INSERTs after the tombstone clears it and resurrects the deleted row in users_v2.

delete_user ON CONFLICT updates only deleted_at and never email, while copy_users overwrites email. Interleavings can leave a tombstone with stale email or let a stale copy overwrite the tombstone email while resurrecting the row.

update_email writes only users.email while copy_users reads users.email into users_v2. A concurrent SELECT can read stale email and the later per-row INSERT overwrites fresher state, leaving users_v2 stale.

tests.name: delete_vs_copy_resurrection
tests.rationale: copy SELECT with LIMIT 1 sees id=1 before delete removes it, then its INSERT ... deleted_at=NULL runs after delete tombstone INSERT, clearing deleted_at and resurrecting the row. LIMIT 1 keeps SELECT cardinality 1 whether it sees id=1 or id=2.

invariants.description: deleted user must stay deleted in users
deleted user must stay tombstoned in users_v2

tests.name: rollout_update_delete_copy
tests.rationale: models rolling deployment with old release, new release and backfill together on same id. Stale copy read of old or updated email followed by INSERT after tombstone clears deleted_at, losing the delete.

invariants.description: deleted user must stay deleted in users despite concurrent v1 update
deleted user must stay tombstoned despite backfill

tests.name: stale_v2_email_and_resurrection
tests.rationale: users_v2 starts with stale email. Correct delete should overwrite email even on conflict and stay tombstoned. Buggy delete leaves stale email when copy misses id=1, and buggy copy clears tombstone when its stale read INSERTs after tombstone.

invariants.description: deleted user must stay deleted in users
tombstone should carry latest email, delete must update email on conflict
